summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 5 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason / action |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap | No screening on record. Frailty (cond-00189) marked entered in error by Dr. Lin today (comm-00301), so frailty plus advanced illness no longer excludes her; donepezil alone doesn't. No other exclusion. FIT ordered sr-t0007; message comm-t0008. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16–08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished; she revoked it to join a clinical trial, per doc-00402). No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap | Corrected FIT obs-01732: collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so outside 2026. No other screening. FIT ordered sr-t0001; message comm-t0004. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap | 06/2024 stool DNA test (obs-01871) entered in error: specimen belonged to another patient (doc-00401). 2025 colonoscopy order sr-00003 never done, so it doesn't count. FIT ordered sr-t0002; message comm-t0005. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap | FIT obs-73001 (01/08/2026) cancelled; re-issued as obs-05001 with collection date 12/28/2025, outside 2026 (doc-00403). FIT ordered sr-t0003; message comm-t0006. |

- All FIT orders run 10/23–12/31/2026 and none had an earlier active FIT order.
- Messages say the kit is coming, explain how to collect and return it, and make no false claims.
- The five new inbox items (inbox-a0001 to a0005) were reviewed and closed with comments and links. Every decision was recorded after reading them, so nothing had to be corrected.
- Other inbox items were left as they were.
